2608.07299.title: EliSeg: Verified Target Construction for Report-Grounded Abnormality Segmentation
2608.07299.paper_summary: Radiology reports describe clinical observations but do not specify executable segmentation targets. They may contain present, negated, prior,uncertain, or irrelevant findings, while multiple valid abnormalities may coexist. Existing segmentation methods largely bypass this ambiguity by receiving a target identity or spatial prompt before inference, which acts as a hidden target oracle. We study report-grounded abnormality segmentation, where a model must determine target eligibility, cardinality, and finding-to-mask correspondence directly from an unfiltered report before delineating the corresponding regions. We propose \textbf{EliSeg}, an atcor--verify--revise framework that integrates target construction with mask generation. A grammar-constrained Actor proposes target slots and masks, an independent text-only Verifier reconstructs the eligible finding inventory, and Revision selectively re-executes the shared Actor when their target structures disagree. EliSeg requires no predefined target identity, finding prompt, point, or bounding box. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR-ILS show that EliSeg consistently outperforms direct segmentation methods and extract-then-segment cascades across findings, while effectively suppressing masks for ineligible report mentions. Ablation studies confirm the complementary roles of verification and revision, and evaluation on CheXlocalize demonstrates effective transfer of the EliSeg to an external dataset.Code is available at https://github.com/Maybach-dream/EliSeg.
2608.07299.paper_summary_zh: 放射科報告描述臨床觀察，但並未具體說明可執行的分割目標。它們可能包含當前、否定、先前、不確定或無關的發現，而多個有效的異常可能共存。現有的分割方法在推理之前通常會通過接收目標身份或空間提示來繞過這種模糊性，這相當於一個隱藏的目標神諭。我們研究報告基礎的異常分割，其中模型必須直接從未過濾的報告中確定目標的合格性、基數和發現與掩膜的對應關係，然後再劃定相應的區域。我們提出了\textbf{EliSeg}，一個整合目標構建與掩膜生成的atcor--verify--revise框架。一個受語法約束的演員提出目標槽和掩膜，一個獨立的僅文本驗證者重建合格的發現庫，而修訂在它們的目標結構不一致時選擇性地重新執行共享的演員。EliSeg不需要預定義的目標身份、發現提示、點或邊界框。在MIMIC-CXR-ILS上的實驗顯示，EliSeg在各種發現上始終超越直接分割方法和提取後分割的級聯，同時有效抑制不合格報告提及的掩膜。消融研究確認了驗證和修訂的互補角色，而在CheXlocalize上的評估則展示了EliSeg對外部數據集的有效轉移。代碼可在 https://github.com/Maybach-dream/EliSeg 獲得。
